title: Review Council subsystem triage result
description: Exclusions ONLY. Every (persona, subsystem) cell the triage agent does not name here is dispatched. A truncated, empty or malformed response can therefore only ever mean more review, never less — fail-open is a property of this shape rather than of remembering to handle each failure downstream.

exclusions.description: Cells the agent judges to hold nothing for that persona. An empty array is a valid, meaningful answer: every persona reviews every subsystem.

subsystem.description: The `name` of an entry in subsystems.json, verbatim. A name that does not appear there is dropped.

persona.description: Persona base name (adversary, curator, guard, sre, testing) — not the agent filename. A name outside the discovered roster is dropped.

reason.description: Why this subsystem holds nothing in that persona's lens, in terms of what the subsystem contains. Published verbatim beside the skipped reviewer in the report and the PR comment, so a maintainer can judge the exclusion without re-reading the diff. A minimum length is enforced because 'not relevant' is not a reason anyone can check.
